parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid. Inner join compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1827' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles.
